scope: deduplicated split rows from Tatoeba and sampled WTO only; large QNL OCR documents excluded from word-trigram LSH due time/RAM cost
metric: Jaccard over normalized word trigrams using existing MinHash/LSH implementation

statistics.similarity_metric: Jaccard over normalized Unicode word trigrams
limitations: Surface similarity is not semantic equivalence.
All flagged pairs are retained for review.
LSH may miss similar pairs; detected pairs are surface-similarity candidates only.
QNL long documents have exact and normalized duplicate checks, but no word-trigram LSH scan.
No candidate was deleted or merged; review is required before any data exclusion.

pair_split_classification.interpretation: near-duplicate LSH candidates only; cross-split candidates are flagged for human review and are not asserted semantic leakage
